heading: Additional Operational Requirements for Social Consumption Establishments

contentTree.heading: Additional Operational Requirements for Social Consumption Establishments

children.content:
In addition to the general operational requirements for Marijuana Establishments required
under {{ref:500.105}}, and except as otherwise provided in {{ref:500.141}}, a Social
Consumption Establishment shall comply with {{ref:500.110}}, and additional operational
requirements under {{ref:500.140}} and {{ref:500.141}}.

Written Policies and Procedures. In addition to the written operating policies required under
{{ref:500.105(1)}}, prior to commencing operations, a Social Consumption Establishment
shall maintain and adhere to written policies and procedures for the sale, distribution, packaging
and serving of Marijuana and Marijuana Products and provide in-house training to employees
to the extent not covered in Responsible Vendor Training Program courses or other required
trainings on such policies and procedures. In-house training provided under {{ref:500.141(2)}} may be counted toward the eight-hour total training requirement required under {{ref:500.105(2)(a)}}. Such written policies and procedures shall include, without limitation:

Written Policies and Procedures. In addition to the written operating policies required under
{{ref:500.105(1)}}, prior to commencing operations, a Social Consumption Establishment
shall maintain and adhere to written policies and procedures for the sale, distribution, packaging
and serving of Marijuana and Marijuana Products and provide in-house training to employees
to the extent not covered in Responsible Vendor Training Program courses or other required
trainings on such policies and procedures. In-house training provided under {{ref:500.141(2)}} may be counted toward the eight-hour total training requirement required under {{ref:500.105(2)(a)}}. Such written policies and procedures shall include, without limitation:

Procedures to ensure that all sales and service of Marijuana and Marijuana Products
under a Social Consumption Establishment license comply with {{ref:500.141(4)(a)}};

Procedures that describe sales and service practices, including but not limited to
procedures for order taking, product handling, portioning, delivery to Consumers, and
ensuring that all sales and service activities are conducted in compliance with {{ref:500.140}} and {{ref:500.141}}. Such procedures shall include a description of dose
verification practices to ensure that any Marijuana Products offered for consumption
on-site are sold or served in accordance with the limitations established in {{ref:500.141(3)}};

Procedures to ensure that only Marijuana or Marijuana Products purchased on the
Premises are consumed at the Social Consumption Establishment;

Procedures that ensure that only Marijuana Accessories provided or sold by the
Social Consumption Establishment are used on the Premises;

Procedures to ensure that Marijuana or Marijuana Products purchased on-site do not
leave the Premises; except as otherwise authorized in an opaque child-resistant sealed
exit bag or an opaque child-resistant sealed exit container suitable for liquids under
{{ref:500.141(3)(b)}}3. and {{ref:500.141(4)(k)}};

Procedures for the storage of Marijuana or Marijuana Products at a Social
Consumption Establishment in accordance with Storage Requirements in {{ref:500.105(11)}}. Marijuana Event Organizers shall create procedures for the temporary
storage of Marijuana, Marijuana Products and Marijuana Accessories at Temporary
Consumption Events;

Procedures for the identification and Waste of unconsumed, abandoned, or
unattended Marijuana or Marijuana Products in accordance with {{ref:500.105(12)}};

Procedures for Marijuana Event Organizers to describe the orderly preparation,
execution, and clean-up of the Temporary Consumption Event from set-up to the closing;

Procedures outlining how a Licensee will assist Consumers who may be impaired
due to consumption of Marijuana or Marijuana Products in the Social Consumption
Establishment by assisting the Customer with means of transportation or other services.
Such requirements shall be tailored to the Host Community or region in which the Social
Consumption Establishment is located and reviewed for comments by the municipality's
chief law enforcement officer. The Commission shall take the chief law enforcement
officer's opinion into consideration in determining whether to approve the impaired
Consumer transportation assistance SOP, provided that the chief law enforcement
officer's opinion shall not be determinative. If no response is received from the chief law
enforcement officer or delegee within 30 days of submitting the request to the chief law
enforcement officer, the Commission shall proceed with its review;

Emergency response procedures where Social Consumption Establishments shall
contact emergency responders if a Consumer demonstrates signs of unresponsiveness or
medical distress in accordance with {{ref:500.110(9)(a)}}10. These procedures shall
require a Marijuana Establishment Agent(s) to remain with the Consumer until
emergency responders arrive;

Procedures to ensure that no one younger than 21 years old may access the
establishment;

If Indoor Smoking Consumption Areas are allowed by the Social Consumption
Establishment, including the ability for Consumers to use the methods of combustion
smoke, heat, vaporization or aerosolization indoors, procedures and building plans or
schematics to ensure compliance with {{ref:500.141(10)}};

If Outdoor Smoking Consumption Areas are allowed by the Social Consumption
Establishment, including the ability for Consumers to use the methods of combustion
smoke, heat, vaporization or aerosolization outdoors, procedures and building plans or
schematics to ensure compliance with {{ref:500.141(11)}};
Procedures to ensure that smoking or consuming Tobacco is prohibited;

Sanitary practices in compliance with 105 CMR 590.000 and 105 CMR 300.000,
if applicable;
Procedures to ensure the cleaning and sanitation of all Consumption Areas;

A detailed description of intended training(s) for Marijuana Establishment Agents
who will be employees;

Policies to ensure that Marijuana Establishment Agents do not consume Marijuana
or Marijuana Products while at work; and

A Social Consumption Establishment Licensee shall update its standard operating
procedures when utilizing new consumption technologies or Marijuana Accessories in
its Indoor Smoking Consumption Areas in order to limit second-hand smoke or vapor
and in accordance with {{ref:500.104(5)}}.
Limitation on Sales.
Limitation on Sales.

General Requirements.
1. All Marijuana and Marijuana Products offered at a Social Consumption Establishment
shall be sourced in compliance with {{ref:500.105}}, and shall have undergone testing
in accordance with {{ref:500.160}} prior to sale or service.
2. A Marijuana Establishment Agent shall not sell Marijuana or Marijuana Products to
any individual in excess of the limitations set forth in {{extref:M.G.L. c. 94G, § 7}}, {{ref:500.140(3)(a)}}, {{ref:500.140(4)(c)}} and {{ref:500.150(4)(a)}} and (b).

Point-of-Service Limitations.
1. At the Point-of-Service, a Social Consumption Establishment shall not serve to a
Consumer at one time more than one-half of the limits established in {{extref:M.G.L. c. 94G, § 7}},
{{ref:500.140(3)(a)}}, and {{ref:500.140(4)(c)}}.
2. A Social Consumption Establishment may maintain an Open Bill for a Consumer;
provided however, that the sale or service of Marijuana or Marijuana Products complies
with {{ref:500.141(3)(a)}}2. and {{ref:500.141(3)(b)}}1.
3. A Marijuana Establishment Agent may sell or serve Marijuana or Marijuana Products
in excess of the Point-of-Service limits set forth in {{ref:500.141(3)(b)}}1.; provided
however, all sales and service comply with {{ref:500.141(3)(a)}}2.; and provided
further, that a Marijuana Establishment Agent shall place all Marijuana or Marijuana
Products in excess of the Point-of-Service limits set forth in {{ref:500.141(3)(b)}}1.
directly into an opaque child-resistant sealed exit bag prior to being provided to the
Consumer.

Repackaging and Portioning of Marijuana Products. A Social Consumption
Establishment may Repackage or portion servings of Marijuana-infused Products, including
Edibles, Beverages and tinctures, into single or multiple-serving sizes for sale or service to
Consumers; provided however, that all individual serving sizes shall comply with the serving
size limitations of {{ref:500.105(6)}} and all potency limitations established in {{ref:500.150(4)}}.
Other Sales.

Other Sales.
1. Sale of Shelf-stable Products. A Social Consumption Establishment shall sell
non-infused food, water, and drink items that are pre-packaged prior to arrival on the
Premises and are Shelf-stable. Such sales of Shelf-stable Products shall be limited to
products sold in a manner that does not cause the Social Consumption Establishment to
be considered a Food Establishment under 105 CMR 590.001. A Social Consumption
Establishment shall obtain all licenses and permits, as necessary, prior to the sale of
Shelf-stable products. Such Shelf-stable Products shall be stored or refrigerated
separately from all Marijuana and Marijuana Products. A Social Consumption
Establishment shall not sell alcohol or Tobacco.
2. Sale of Food. The Department of Public Health and the applicable local Board of
Health have jurisdiction over the sale of non-infused food and drink. A Social
Consumption Establishment shall obtain necessary permits, or other authorizations from
the Department of Public Health pursuant to 105 CMR 590.000, and any local ordinances
or by-laws prior to sale of non-infused food and drink. All non-infused food and drinks
shall be stored, refrigerated, and prepared separately from Marijuana and Marijuana
Products. Nothing in {{ref:500.141}}, shall be construed to authorize the Commission
to license or regulate Food Establishments.

Sale of Outside Food. A Social Consumption Establishment may allow sales or
delivery of non-infused food or drinks for consumption on-site from a Food
Establishment holding a valid permit issued pursuant to 105 CMR 590.000. The
allowance of outside non-infused food or drinks from a Food Establishment shall not, by
itself, cause a Social Consumption Establishment to be considered a Food Establishment
under 105 CMR 590.001: Purpose and Definitions.
4. Sale and Use of Accessories. A Social Consumption Establishment may sell
Marijuana Accessories. A Social Consumption Establishment may rent or provide
Marijuana Accessories for use by Consumers in Consumption Areas; provided however,
all Marijuana Accessories for rent or use by Consumers that are not disposable or for
single-use, must be thoroughly cleansed and properly sterilized prior to rental or use, and
after rental or use by each Consumer.
5. Access to Consumer Support Items. A Social Consumption Establishment may
provide access to or sell products intended to assist Consumers in alleviating or
mitigating the effects of intoxication from Marijuana or Marijuana Products; provided
however, that the Social Consumption Establishment shall maintain documentation
demonstrating the basis for the product's intended use, including but not limited to
manufacturer descriptions, product labeling, or other materials, which shall be made
available to the Commission or the municipality upon request. Consumer support items
shall not be marketed or represented as medical treatment and shall be offered only in
compliance with all applicable laws.
6. Sale of Other Items. A Social Consumption Establishment may sell items not
expressly authorized herein only after receiving the express written permission of the
Host Community of the Supplemental On-site Social Consumption Establishment or
Hospitality On-site Social Consumption Establishment, or, for a Marijuana Event
Organizer, the municipality where a Temporary Consumption Event is located; provided
however, that the sale of any items not expressly authorized herein complies with
{{ref:500.141(9)}}. Such express written permission shall be submitted to the
Commission pursuant to {{ref:500.101(3)(i)}}8. and updated upon any change in
accordance with {{ref:500.104(5)}}.
Social Consumption Establishment Sales.
Social Consumption Establishment Sales.

Except as otherwise authorized in {{ref:500.141(3)}}, the sale of Marijuana and
Marijuana Products for consumption on-site shall take place in compliance with the
following:
1. Marijuana and Marijuana Products may only be used by Consumers on the Premises
who have demonstrated in compliance with {{ref:500.141(5)}} that they are 21 years
of age or older.
2. A Social Consumption Establishment shall use Automatic Identification Technology
to provide Consumers with access to Certificates of Analysis, and may use AIT to
provide Consumers with access to menus, Consumer education information, access to
Marijuana or Marijuana Product labels, and any additional content or materials as may
be determined by the Commission; provided however, that a Social Consumption
Establishment utilizing AIT is prohibited from collecting, storing, or using any Consumer
personal data through such technology.
3. In addition to the requirements of {{ref:500.140(6)}}, a Social Consumption
Establishment shall readily display a Consumer information card to each Consumer at
the point of sale or service or within the Consumption Area. A Social Consumption
Establishment may use Automatic Identification Technology to display the Consumer
information card, or provide visible signage at the point of sale or service or in the
Consumption Area. Visible Signage shall contain the same information as the Consumer
information card. The content shall include the following:
a. Content provided by the Commission that informs Consumers about the
impairment effects of different forms of consumption of Marijuana or Marijuana
Products including, but not limited to, the length of time that the Marijuana or
Marijuana Products may take in order to take effect, and information to prevent
impaired driving. The content of the information card or visible signage will be
scientifically based on available and current public health research.

b. For Edibles, Marijuana-infused Products, or for Beverages, the warning, "The
impairment effects of Marijuana-infused Products may be impacted or delayed up to
two hours or more depending on several factors, including but not limited to,
potency, method of consumption, amount consumed, alcohol consumption,
non-infused food and drink consumption prior to and during the use of Marijuana and
Marijuana Products, and body-weight, previous use, prescription medication used and
tolerance of the Consumer, and may cause psychosis."
4. In addition to the requirements of {{ref:500.105(5)}}, a Social Consumption
Establishment shall ensure that all Marijuana and Marijuana Products sold or served
on-site are accompanied by an Automatic Identification Technology, menu, label, or
supplementary insert provided to the Consumer that includes:
a. The estimated amount of time for the onset effects of Marijuana and Marijuana
Products and the projected duration of the effects for each specific product offered
for sale by the Licensee; and
b. Access to the Certificate of Analysis for each batch of Marijuana and Marijuana
Products available for sale or service. A Social Consumption Establishment shall
make individual package Certificates available to Consumers upon request.

A Social Consumption Establishment shall not allow the consumption of alcohol or
Tobacco, or the sale of alcohol or Tobacco on its Premises.

Hospitality On-Site Consumption Licensee or Marijuana Event Organizer Licensee shall
not allow consumption by Consumers in a space that is shared with another entity serving
alcohol unless there is a physical barrier to the Consumption Areas and Premises or alcohol
sales are not offered at the same time as consumption of Marijuana or Marijuana Products
by Consumers.

A Supplemental On-Site Consumption Licensee that also has a valid Marijuana Retailer
license may conduct both social consumption sales in compliance with {{ref:500.141}}
and retail sales in compliance with {{ref:500.140}}. A Social Consumption Establishment
shall ensure that Marijuana and Marijuana Products purchased for consumption on-site are
distinguished from Marijuana and Marijuana Products purchased for retail sale through the
Seed-to-sale SOR. Marijuana and Marijuana Products purchased for retail sale shall not be
consumed on-site.

All Marijuana and Marijuana Product sales shall be tracked by Social Consumption
Establishments using the Seed-to-sale SOR. Marijuana Establishments licensed to operate
Supplemental On-site Consumption Establishments in its existing Marijuana Establishment
Premises shall ensure separation of sales under the Marijuana Establishment license and sales
under the Social Consumption Establishment License. Marijuana Establishments selling
Marijuana and Marijuana Products through a Marijuana Event Organizer Licensee at
Temporary Consumption Events shall track such sales in the Seed-to-sale SOR and shall
provide this information to the Social Consumption Establishment.

Limitations on the time for sales of Marijuana or Marijuana Products shall comply with
all municipal bylaws and ordinances. Unless otherwise explicitly authorized by the
municipality, sales and service shall only occur between the hours of 7:00 A.M. and
12:00 A.M., and shall cease no later than 30 minutes prior to the latest time the licensee is
authorized to conduct sales under {{ref:500.000}}. Nothing in this subsection shall
prohibit a licensee from continuing to operate or conduct other lawful business activities,
including the sale of non-Marijuana items such as non-infused food or drink, or
entertainment, after the sale and service of Marijuana and Marijuana Products cease.

Every effort shall be made to minimize the amount of cash held by a Social
Consumption Licensee at any one time. Licensees shall use reasonable efforts to implement
platforms for the electronic payment of funds.

A Social Consumption Establishment shall prohibit the sale and consumption of
Marijuana or Marijuana Products by a visibly intoxicated Consumer.

A Social Consumption Establishment shall adopt separate accounting practices at the
point of sale for Marijuana, Marijuana Products, and non-Marijuana sales.

A Consumer's presence at a licensed Social Consumption Establishment during
permitted hours of operation shall be presumed lawful and shall not constitute loitering.

The Social Consumption Establishment shall offer Consumers an opaque child-resistant
sealed exit bag to take unconsumed or partially consumed Marijuana or Marijuana Products
from the Premises; provided however, that any open Beverage, or any drink or other liquid
that becomes infused by a Consumer on the Premises shall be consumed on-site and may not
be removed from the Premises, unless secured in an opaque child-resistant sealed exit
container suitable for liquids provided by the Social Consumption Establishment.
Age Verification.
Age Verification.

Entry into the Premises of a Social Consumption Establishment by Persons younger than
21 years old is prohibited.

A Social Consumption Establishment shall conduct age verification upon entry using
ID scanning software.

On entry into the Premises of a Social Consumption Establishment by an individual, a
Marijuana Establishment Agent shall immediately inspect, using ID scanning software, the
individual's proof of identification and determine the individual's age. An individual may not
be admitted to the Premises, unless the Marijuana Establishment Agent has verified, using
ID scanning software, that the individual is 21 years of age or older by an individual's proof
of identification.
Consumption Areas.
Consumption Areas.

Access to Consumption Areas.
1. Access to Consumption Areas is restricted to Consumers, Marijuana Establishment
Agents, outside vendors and contractors, agents of the Commission, Commission
Delegees, state and local personnel acting within their lawful jurisdictions, and police,
fire departments, and emergency medical services acting in the course of their official
capacity.
2. {{ref:500.000}} shall not be construed to prohibit access to authorized state or
local Law enforcement Authorities or public health, inspectional services, or other
permit-granting agents acting within their lawful jurisdiction.

Separation of Consumption Areas from Sales and Service.
1. A Social Consumption Establishment that allows an Indoor Smoking Consumption
Area or an Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area shall separate the designated sales and
service areas from Consumption Areas. Each Indoor Smoking Consumption Area and
Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area shall be isolated from other non-smoking areas of
the establishment.
2. Indoor Non-Smoking Consumption Areas and Outdoor Non-Smoking Consumption
Areas may separate the designated sales and service areas from Consumption Areas.
3. The Indoor Smoking Consumption Area shall be an Enclosed Space separated from
the sales and service areas with a secure door and shall only be accessible from the sales
area in Supplemental On-site Consumption and Hospitality On-site Consumption
establishments. For Marijuana Event Organizers operating a Temporary Consumption
Event, the Indoor Smoking Consumption Area shall be an Enclosed Space accessible
only through a secure door.
4. The Outdoor Smoking Consumption Areas in a Supplemental On-site Consumption
or Hospitality On-site Consumption establishment shall be separated from the indoor
portion of the Social Consumption Establishment's Premises by walls or other barriers
and a secure door, and shall be separated from sales and service areas. Outdoor Smoking
Consumption Areas shall be accessible only from the sales area in a Supplemental
On-site Consumption or Hospitality On-site Consumption establishment.
5. Marijuana Event Organizers shall submit as part of its Event Plan an explanation and
diagram where Indoor Smoking Consumption Areas or Outdoor Smoking Consumption
Areas are located. An Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area shall be at least 30 feet away
from the sales areas. The Marijuana Event Organizer shall separate sales and service
areas taking place in temporary or mobile structures, including but not limited to tents,
trailers, trucks, or other enclosures, from Outdoor Smoking Consumption Areas.

Monitoring of Consumption Areas.
1. Visibility of the Indoor Smoking Consumption Areas and Outdoor Smoking
Consumption Areas shall be observed by Marijuana Establishment Agents via natural
sight, through windows, or via CCTV or a similar monitoring technology.
2. A Supplemental On-site Consumption establishment and a Hospitality On-site
Consumption establishment's Consumption Areas shall have clear, unobstructed camera
coverage as follows:

a. Cameras shall be of quality sufficient to capture a clear, still image, whether live
or recorded;
b.
Cameras shall cover all entrances or reasonable areas of ingress to the
Consumption Areas;
c. Cameras shall be angled in at designated entrances to allow clear and certain
identification of any person entering or exiting the Consumption Area;
d. Cameras shall be placed in such a way as to monitor all locked receptacles for the
disposal, of abandoned, discarded, or unattended Marijuana or Marijuana Products.
e. If a licensee cannot comply with {{ref:500.110(2)}} due to conflicting laws or
regulations, it shall submit a request for an Alternative Security Provision under
{{ref:500.110(2)}}.
3. Marijuana Event Organizers shall at minimum provide camera coverage for all sales
areas.

Location of Consumption Areas.
1. A Social Consumption Establishment shall provide signage to designate the approved
Consumption Area(s), and shall employ additional physical or visual markers to inform
Consumers and Marijuana Establishment Agents of the boundaries of the Consumption
Area(s).
2. A Consumption Area shall be located only within areas of the Premises approved by
the Commission for on-site consumption and shall comply with the following:
a. A Consumption Area shall not be located at or within any Limited Access Areas.
b. A Consumption Area shall not be located within any restroom, janitorial, or
storage areas.
3. For a Supplemental On-site Social Consumption Establishment, a Consumption Area
shall not be located at or within any retail sales counter, retail point-of-sale station, retail
queuing area, or other area designated for the retail sale or payment of Marijuana or
Marijuana Products, and shall not intersect with ingress or egress areas for retail sales.
4. The Marijuana Establishment shall maintain an accurate and up-to-date diagram of
the Consumption Areas which shall show the location of:
a.
The licensed Premises of the Marijuana Establishment or Temporary
Consumption Event;
b. Consumption Areas, sales areas, service areas, and food service areas, if
applicable;
c. Ventilation exhaust points, if applicable;
d. The employee monitoring area;
e. Doors, windows, or other exits; and
f. Any other information required by the Commission.

Indoor Consumption Areas.
1. A Supplemental On-site Consumption licensee that operates in a Marijuana Retailer,
and operates an Indoor Non-Smoking Consumption Area, may continue retail operations,
and may allow retail sales and social consumption sales and service to occur at the same
time; provided however that all Consumption Areas comply with {{ref:500.141(6)}}.
2.
Consumption of Marijuana or Marijuana Products in an Indoor Smoking
Consumption Area shall comply with {{ref:500.141(10)}}. Further:
a. A Supplemental On-site Consumption Licensee shall not operate an Indoor
Smoking Consumption Area at the same time as the existing Marijuana
Establishment if they operate in the same space and during the same operating hours.
b. A Supplemental On-site Consumption Licensee shall ensure that the Indoor
Smoking Consumption Areas are separated from the existing Marijuana
Establishment's operations by an Enclosed Space approved by the Commission.
c. A Hospitality On-site Consumption Licensee and a Marijuana Event Organizer
shall ensure that Indoor Smoking Consumption Areas within a new or existing
Non-Cannabis Entity are separate from the new or existing Non-Cannabis Entity's
operations by having an Enclosed Space approved by the Commission.

A Social Consumption Establishment shall provide Consumers with adequate, readily
accessible toilet facilities that are maintained in a sanitary condition and in good repair.

If an emergency requires law enforcement personnel, firefighters, emergency medical
services providers, or other public safety workers to enter an Indoor Smoking Consumption
Area or an Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area, the Social Consumption Establishment
shall cease the combustion, heat, vaporization, or aerosolization of Marijuana and Marijuana
Products if requested by such officials until such public safety workers have completed their
investigation or services and have left the Premises.
Waste Disposal.
Waste Disposal.

The Social Consumption Establishment shall provide Consumers at least one locked
receptacle in a Consumption Area for the disposal of unwanted, unattended, abandoned, or
discarded Marijuana or Marijuana Products. Where combustion or heat is used to consume
Marijuana or Marijuana Products, the locked receptacles shall be fireproof.

The Social Consumption Establishment shall ensure the Consumption Area is regularly
checked for abandoned, discarded, or unattended Marijuana or Marijuana Products and shall
promptly dispose of the same in the locked receptacle.

Social Consumption Establishments shall ensure that all Marijuana and Marijuana
Products are properly wasted in accordance with {{ref:500.105(12)}}. The locked
receptacle shall be emptied, and the Marijuana and Marijuana Products shall be properly
wasted no later than at the end of each day, or when the receptacle is at capacity, whichever
occurs first.

Marijuana or Marijuana Products returned by a Consumer shall be disposed of in
accordance with {{ref:500.105(12)}}.
Incident Reporting.
Incident Reporting.

The Social Consumption Establishment shall provide notice to appropriate Law
Enforcement Authorities and the Commission in accordance with {{ref:500.110(9)}}.

In addition to the incidents identified in {{ref:500.110(9)(a)}}, a Social Consumption
Establishment shall notify the Commission of any of the following incidents immediately,
or if circumstances prevent immediate reporting, no more than 24 hours after the following:
1. Any consumption of Tobacco or alcohol on the Premises;
2. Any instance involving the consumption of any Marijuana or Marijuana Product at
the Social Consumption Establishment by a Consumer that was not purchased from the
Social Consumption Establishment;
3. Any instance involving the consumption of any Marijuana or Marijuana Product from
the Social Consumption Establishment being consumed in any area outside the
designated Consumption Area and on the Premises;
4. Any instance in which the Social Consumption Establishment has actual knowledge,
through formal notice or by direct communication, from federal, state or local officials,
Marijuana Establishment Agents, or insurance companies, that a Consumer who
patronized the Social Consumption Establishment was arrested for operating under the
influence of marijuana as prohibited by {{extref:M.G.L. c. 90, § 24}}.
5. Any instance involving the entry onto the Premises by, or sales or service to, an
individual younger than 21 years old; or
6. Any instance in which the ventilation or filtration system in an Indoor Smoking
Consumption Area fails or stops functioning properly.
Prohibitions. A Social Consumption Establishment shall not:
Prohibitions. A Social Consumption Establishment shall not:
Sell Marijuana or Marijuana Products other than those authorized pursuant to {{ref:500.141}}.

Permit the sale or consumption of Marijuana or Marijuana Products in violation of
{{ref:500.160}}.

Infuse or combine Marijuana or Marijuana Products with food or drink by a Marijuana
Establishment Agent at the Social Consumption Establishment. Nothing in {{ref:500.141(9)}} shall prohibit a Consumer from infusing their own food or drink with Marijuana
or Marijuana Products that have been lawfully purchased at the Social Consumption
Establishment.

Allow any Marijuana Establishment Agent to consume Marijuana or Marijuana Products
during the course of a work shift;
Allow the sale or consumption of Tobacco or alcohol on the Premises;

Allow the consumption of any Marijuana or Marijuana Product that was not purchased
from the Social Consumption Establishment;

Advertise, market or brand any practice prohibited under {{ref:500.141(9)}} or
{{ref:500.105(4)(b)}};
Allow consumption outside of designated Consumption Areas; and

Permit Marijuana or Marijuana Products to be sold or served to an intoxicated
Consumer.
Indoor Smoking Consumption Area Requirements.
Indoor Smoking Consumption Area Requirements.
The prohibition on smoking of Tobacco indoors cannot be waived.

Social Consumption Establishments shall not allow combustion, heat, vaporization, or
aerosolization of Marijuana or Marijuana Products indoors unless expressly permitted by the
Commission in an authorized Indoor Smoking Consumption Area.
The Indoor Smoking Consumption Area is compliant with all fire codes.

Social Consumption Establishments with an Indoor Smoking Consumption Area shall
provide Marijuana Establishment Agents with adequate Personal Protective Equipment and
shall provide options to Marijuana Establishment Agents to view the Indoor Smoking
Consumption Areas in a smoke-free, and vapor-free area.
1. A Social Consumption Establishment shall not prohibit or restrict a Marijuana
Establishment Agent from wearing or using Personal Protective Equipment while
working in or around an Indoor Smoking Consumption Area.
2. A Social Consumption Establishment shall comply with all applicable OSHA
requirements.

Social Consumption Establishments with an Indoor Smoking Consumption Area shall
include:
1. A ventilation system within the Indoor Smoking Consumption Area that shall
maintain negative air pressure relative to adjacent spaces at all times of operation.
2. A separate ventilation system within the Indoor Smoking Consumption Area shall be
capable of 20 complete air changes per hour at a minimum. Excess air required to create
negative air pressure volume must be directly exhausted to the outdoors in compliance
with all applicable building and fire codes and environmental regulations.
3. A separate system within the rest of the Social Consumption Establishment that shall
be capable of six complete air changes per hour at a minimum. Excess air required to
create negative pressure volume must be directly exhausted to the outdoors in compliance
with all applicable building and fire codes and environmental regulations.
4. A Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value (MERV) 14 or higher filtration system shall
be capable of handling the entire volume of air within the Indoor Smoking Consumption
Area, or an equivalent system pursuant to {{ref:500.141(10)(g)}};
5. Odor control equipment sufficient to mitigate cannabis odor from being detected
outside the limits of the Premises.

Prior to final licensure, a Social Consumption Establishment with an Indoor Smoking
Consumption Area shall demonstrate compliance with {{ref:500.141(10)}} by submitting
a ventilation and filtration compliance letter, bearing the stamp and signature of a
Massachusetts Licensed Mechanical Engineer in accordance with {{extref:M.G.L. c. 112, § 81}}M,
together with supporting documentation, including but not limited to plans, computations,
and specifications demonstrating system design and performance.

Notwithstanding {{ref:500.141(10)(e)}}, a Social Consumption Establishment may
submit an alternative ventilation and filtration plan, bearing the stamp and signature of a
Massachusetts Licensed Mechanical Engineer in accordance with {{extref:M.G.L. c. 112, § 81}}M,
together with supporting documentation, including but not limited to plans, computations,
and specifications demonstrating system design, performance, and demonstrating protection
of Consumers and Marijuana Establishment Agents at least equivalent to the requirements
of {{ref:500.141(10)(e)}}. The plan shall set forth performance criteria and proposed
monitoring methods to demonstrate ongoing compliance with {{ref:500.141(10)}}.

A Social Consumption Establishment with an Indoor Smoking Consumption Area shall
maintain and demonstrate ongoing compliance with {{ref:500.141(10)}}. At a minimum,
the Social Consumption Establishment shall:

A Social Consumption Establishment with an Indoor Smoking Consumption Area shall
maintain and demonstrate ongoing compliance with {{ref:500.141(10)}}. At a minimum,
the Social Consumption Establishment shall:
1. Obtain certification, bearing the stamp and signature of a Massachusetts Licensed
Mechanical Engineer in accordance with {{extref:M.G.L. c. 112, § 81}}M, demonstrating continued
compliance with {{ref:500.141(10)(e)}}, or with the performance criteria set forth in
an alternative ventilation and filtration plan pursuant to {{ref:500.141(10)(g)}}, if
applicable, not less than once every 12 months;

Maintain records of all ventilation and filtration system inspections, maintenance,
and repairs for the two most recent certification periods. Such records shall be retained
from the date of each certification of compliance until the next certification is obtained.
Upon issuance of a new annual certification pursuant to {{ref:500.141(10)(h)}}, the
Social Consumption Establishment may archive or dispose of records predating the two
most recent certification periods;
3. For Social Consumption Establishments operating under an alternative ventilation
and filtration plan pursuant to {{ref:500.141(10)(g)}}, maintain records of all
inspections, maintenance, repairs, and monitoring data demonstrating compliance with
the performance criteria set forth in the alternative ventilation and filtration plan for the
two most recent certification periods. Such records shall be retained from the date of
each certification of compliance until the next certification is obtained. Upon issuance
of a new annual certification pursuant to {{ref:500.141(10)(h)}}, the Social
Consumption Establishment may archive or dispose of records predating the two most
recent certification periods; and
4. Make all such records, including inspections, maintenance, repair logs, certifications,
and monitoring data, for the two most recent certification periods available to the
Commission or municipality upon request.

Upon any failure or improper functioning of the ventilation or filtration system or any
alternative ventilation and filtration plan in an Indoor Smoking Consumption Area, a Social
Consumption Establishment shall immediately require all Consumers to cease the
consumption of all Marijuana or Marijuana Products in the Indoor Smoking Consumption
Area and shall ensure that the Indoor Smoking Consumption Area is promptly vacated by
Consumers.
1. The Indoor Smoking Consumption Area shall remain closed to consumption unless
and until the ventilation and filtration system, or any alternative ventilation and filtration
plan, is repaired and functioning appropriately and the Social Consumption
Establishment has complied with {{ref:500.141(10)(j)}}.
2. During the period of closure in accordance with {{ref:500.141(10)(i)}}1., the
Indoor Smoking Consumption Area may be entered only by Marijuana Establishment
Agents, outside vendors and contractors, agents of the Commission, Commission
Delegees, state and local personnel acting within their lawful jurisdictions, and police,
fire department, and emergency medical services personnel acting in the course of their
official duties.
3. No consumption of Marijuana or Marijuana Products shall occur in the Indoor
Smoking Consumption Area for a minimum of 48 hours following the detection of the
ventilation or filtration system failure or improper functioning, or the failure or improper
functioning of any alternative ventilation and filtration plan; provided however, that
beginning 48 hours after the Social Consumption Establishment notifies the Commission
of such failure or improper functioning pursuant to {{ref:500.141(8)(b)}}6., and
continuing until the Social Consumption Establishment has complied with {{ref:500.141(10)(j)}}, the Indoor Smoking Consumption Area may be utilized as an Indoor
Non-Smoking Consumption Area.
4. Notwithstanding {{ref:500.141(10)(i)}}, operation of the Indoor Smoking
Consumption Area may resume at any time if the Social Consumption Establishment has
complied with {{ref:500.141(10)(j)}}.

A Social Consumption Establishment shall report any instance in which the ventilation
or filtration system in the Indoor Smoking Consumption Area fails or stops functioning
properly to the Commission in accordance with {{ref:500.141(8)(b)}}6., as well as the
actions that will be taken to fix the system. Combustion, heat, vaporization, and
aerosolization of Marijuana or Marijuana Products in an Indoor Smoking Consumption Area
shall not resume until the Social Consumption Establishment provides written notice to the
Commission, bearing the stamp and signature of a Massachusetts Licensed Mechanical
Engineer in accordance with M.G.L c. 112, § 81M, together with supporting documentation,
including but not limited to plans, computations, and specifications demonstrating that the
ventilation or filtration system has been repaired, is functioning properly, and complies with
{{ref:500.141(10)(e)}} or, if applicable, the performance criteria in an approved
alternative ventilation and filtration plan under {{ref:500.141(10)(g)}}.

All combustion, heat, vaporization, or aerosolization of Marijuana or Marijuana
Products within an Indoor Smoking Consumption Area shall occur out of plain sight and
shall not be visible from a public place, outside of the Marijuana Establishment, or in the
case of a Temporary Consumption Event, the Event Premises, without the use of binoculars,
optical aids, or aircraft.
Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area Requirements.
Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area Requirements.

An Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area shall be open to the air at all times. The
Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area shall be required to have unobstructed circulation of
outside air to all parts of the Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area. This requirement shall
be met if:
1. The Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area has a ceiling and at least ½ of the total
surface area of the walls and other vertical boundaries of the space permit unobstructed
flow of outside air into the space; or
2. The Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area has no ceiling and no more than two walls
or other barriers or other vertical boundaries of the space that obstruct the flow of air into
the area exceeding 8 feet in height.
The Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area is compliant with all fire codes.

Social Consumption Establishments with an Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area shall
provide Marijuana Establishment Agents with adequate Personal Protective Equipment and
shall provide options to Marijuana Establishment Agents to view the Outdoor Smoking
Consumption Areas in a smoke-free, and vapor-free area.
1. No Social Consumption Establishment shall prohibit or restrict a Marijuana
Establishment Agent from wearing or using Personal Protective Equipment while
working in or around an Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area.
2. A Social Consumption Establishment shall comply with all applicable OSHA
requirements.

Outdoor Smoking Consumption Areas shall:
1. Be clearly marked with appropriate signage;
2. Be physically separated from non-smoking areas and areas accessible to minors;
3. Be regularly cleaned and maintained to minimize waste, odor, and the risk of
Diversion or Inversion of Marijuana and Marijuana Products; and
4. Be monitored to prevent the unlawful consumption or unlawful transfer of Marijuana
or Marijuana Products.
Reasonable efforts are made to mitigate smoke migration to indoor locations.

If an Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area has removable elements, such as ceilings,
walls, other barriers or windows that impede the free flow of outside air, the Consumption
Area shall be considered an Indoor Smoking Consumption Area for the purposes of
compliance with {{ref:500.141(10)}}, when the removable elements are in place.

All combustion, heat, vaporization, or aerosolization of Marijuana or Marijuana
Products within an Outdoor Smoking Consumption Area shall occur out of plain sight and
shall not be visible from a public place, outside of the Marijuana Establishment or, in the
case of a Temporary Consumption Event, the Event Premises, without the use of binoculars,
optical aids, or aircraft.
Marijuana Event Organizer Warehousing.
Marijuana Event Organizer Warehousing.

Notwithstanding the Vault requirements in {{ref:500.110}}, a Marijuana Event
Organizer may operate a Warehouse for the storage of Finished Marijuana, Marijuana
Products, and Marijuana Accessories and for the preparation of sale to consumers at
Temporary Consumption Events. A Marijuana Event Organizer who does not operate a
Warehouse shall indicate to the Commission all Marijuana Establishments who will conduct
sales of Marijuana, Marijuana Products, and Marijuana Accessories, at each Temporary
Consumption Event.

Warehouses shall comply with all applicable requirements for {{ref:500.105}} and
{{ref:500.110}}.

Warehouses shall incorporate a sally port or loading area immediately adjacent to the
Warehouse that enables the Transfer of Finished Marijuana Products to and from Temporary
Consumption Events.
